title: Geometric determinants of time series learning and attractor stability in closed-loop circuits: simulation and analysis code
description:
C++ simulation code and MATLAB analysis scripts accompanying the manuscript "Geometric determinants of time series learning and attractor stability in closed-loop circuits" ([Alessandro Barri, Harsha Gurnani and R. Angus Silver], [preprint]).

The processed data used to generate the figures are archived separately on figshare (see the README of the repository).
